check:
action<>'TASK_ACCEPT' OR COALESCE((JSON_TYPE(frozen_command)='OBJECT' AND
    status='TASK_ACCEPTED' AND
    next_retry_at IS NULL AND
    failure_code IS NULL AND
    version=0 AND
    deleted=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='TASK_ACCEPT_V1' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='ACCEPT_TASK' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))=submission_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))=tenant_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))=entity_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))=store_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))=work_order_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.taskNo'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.taskNo'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))=request_key_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestHash'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestHash'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.recordHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.recordHash'))=payload_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actorNamespace'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actorNamespace'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requiredRosterHash'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requiredRosterHash'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.schema'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.schema'))='RESOURCE_QUALIFICATION_OBSERVATION_V1' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.outcome'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.outcome'))='PROVEN' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.scopeRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.scopeRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.taskVersion'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.taskVersion')>=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.bindingRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.bindingRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.bindingVersion'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.bindingVersion')>=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.sourceFenceRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.sourceFenceRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.publishedTaskRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.publishedTaskRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.selected'))='ARRAY' AND
    JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.selected')) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.result'))='ARRAY' AND
    JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.result')) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.groups'))='ARRAY' AND
    JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.groups')) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND
    JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.selected'))=JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.result')) AND
    JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.selected'))=JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.qualification.groups')) AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.publishedTaskRevision')=JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestVersions.taskVersion')+1 AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":100,"items":{"type":"object","required":["slot","expectedAssignmentRevision"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"slot":{"type":"object","required":["requirementNo","roleCode","sourceLineRef","personnelNo","resourceNo","startAt","endAt","ordinal"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"requirementNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"roleCode":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"sourceLineRef":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"personnelNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"resourceNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"startAt":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"endAt":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"ordinal":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}}},"expectedAssignmentRevision":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}}}}',JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.selected')) AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":100,"items":{"type":"object","required":["assignmentNo","requirementNo","roleCode","validUntil","currentState","ordinal","assignmentRevision"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"assignmentNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"requirementNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"roleCode":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"validUntil":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"currentState":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"ordinal":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"assignmentRevision":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}}}}',JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.result'))),0)
